correctness.rationale: Both inverse branches are positive contractions and their derivatives are legitimate reverse transition weights. Exact all-zero cylinders have masses lambda^n. Transforming y_{n+1}=lambda*y_n-(a/2)*y_n^2 with v_n=(1-a)/y_n yields a linear recurrence plus bounded O((1-a)log(1/(1-a))) accumulated error; the resulting reciprocal limit and monotone CDF brackets prove the universal z/(1+z) law. The proof does not require a planar density. Rational and numerical checks in verify.py returned VERIFY_OK.
